scope: The eight registered systemd user timers only. Existing activation/status receipts, one contemporaneous structured operator receipt and a read-only filesystem metadata observation.
existing_evidence: The registered status snapshots retained configuration state, current activation and last trigger. Neither carried first enable nor the persistent enable-link creation metadata.
filesystem_observation: All eight currently installed timers.target.wants entries were symlinks resolving to the corresponding registered installed unit. The recorded times are the filesystem birth times of those surviving link objects, at whole-second precision. Birth time is evidence of the object’s existence. It cannot establish when an entry first held that name, earlier removal or recreation, or uninterrupted enablement.

historical_observation.scope: The structured completion receipt records observed state for those two timers. It contains no initial installation or previous absence attestation for either.

snapshot_semantics: Explicit enabled snapshot is a dated observation found in the compared receipts. Current activation is the start of the activation still reported in the reused runtime readback. Neither dates the first-ever enable command.
outstanding: An original, attributable first-install/first-enable record, or a complete history from original installation, remains necessary to establish first-ever enablement. The existing activation queries were not repeated.
